{{Quote|The Al'Har system&mdash;of which Haruun Kal is the sole planet—lies on the nexus of several hyperspace lanes: the hub of a wheel called the Gevarno Loop, whose spokes join the Separatist systems of Killisu, Jutrand, Loposi, and the Gevarno Cluster with Opari, Ventran, and Ch'manss&mdash;all loyalist.|Mace Windu (allegedly), ''[[The Private Journals of Mace Windu]]''|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Gevarno Cluster''' was a collection of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[Gevarno Loop]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
The Cluster was loyal to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> whose forces withdrew there following their inability to defend [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[Doolb Snoil]] began his legal career as an apprentice within this Cluster.
